details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, q11) vs ANA's press render (samchui_11). Both round-1 trim faults are fixed. The inter-door posts now render #746757..#94866f (render #8e7f6d), and the counter nosing is a bright steel rail. The layout still matches: blind, monitor, bottle shelf, fridge, 7 ash doors, black counter. Remaining problems: (1) The fridge bottles render as saturated solid blue blobs (#1b3bbb). In the render they are clear bottles with blue labels behind smoked glass (#454876 / #353855). (2) The blind renders pure black #09090b; the render shows #1d1c23 with a soft sheen. (3) In q11 and m06 the canopy reads as a thin floating plank, black on top with a white edge strip, projecting into the aisle. In the render the black soffit sits flush between the flanking lav heads. (4) Monument depth is still MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.05, against about 1.4-1.85 m on the map (not addressed). There is still no in-service photo; OMAAT, TPG, Thrifty, Frugal Flyer, Round-About and the Alviator do not show it.

Door-2 welcome galley (m03, m16) vs lalf_134 / omaat_Room-32. Fixed: bigger landscape monitor, thick steel nosing, aluminium picture frame round the opening, and the dark passage soffit with downlights (renders #565151 vs lalf_133 #5e524b, good). Still wrong: (1) In lalf_134 the black upper unit is narrower than the alcove. Between the glass cabinet and the aisle-end frame is an open, empty recess about 0.35 m wide, with a light-grey back wall and the black counter running into it. The model fills this with black. (2) Under the monitor are two framed open bays behind a shelf lip: the brewer bay and an empty cubby. The model's beverage maker is a free-standing black box standing proud on the counter (m03). (3) The two units over the counter at left are tall stainless chillers with round ring handles. The model shows aluminium 'ovens' with beige label windows. The lower ash doors are fine.

Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13, m16). Fixed: the centre is now the flat ash wall with aluminium-framed flaps, red latches and low rails (buildAshWall, as lalf_133). The 7A closet carries the grey jump seat beside the door (lalf_133), and the J backs are cream. The end panels are charcoal with larger portrait monitors. Unverified: the 7K galley across the passage from R2 (m04, m16) has a white standard upper bank (ovens, brewer, copper latches) over ash lower doors. No photo shows the R2 side; sp_09 shows only ash lower doors and an aluminium edge. The J curtains aft of these monuments stand as poles in the aisle (see curtains).

F front wall, flight-deck door and door 1 (q01, m01, m02). The flight-deck door and ebony corridor still match tpa_IMG_0260. The ink-cloud walls regressed visually: in m02 they read as a plain pale grey. The 10-90 % luminance spread is 5 % on the centre closet and 20 % on the lower left panel. On the wall in tpg_147 / ffF, the horizontal cloud bands give about 18 % (stddev 13 on mean 166), and they run up to the bins. inkWall fades the clouds out with height (lowY) and uses a 0.46 threshold, so the part seen from a seat is blank. The ground is also cool neutral (#cfd1d0) where the photo is warm grey-green (#bab7a6..#9c9988). The F-front curtains were added but are wrong in form (see curtains). ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle shows each F aisle closed off by two full pleated panels, one at each edge of the aisle, untied. In q01 and m02 the model shows a single thin tied pole standing mid-aisle. The q01 door-1 aisle walls are dark ebony (#393232); no photo confirms this.

Lavatory exteriors (m03, m05, m09, m11, m16). J lavs now follow the in-service OMAAT door: plain ash leaf (#c1b59b rendered), white bi-fold seam strip, white vertical grab handle and white lock slot, with no bronze. F is ebony; PY and Y are white with dark occupancy boxes. Still open from round 1: the door-2 forward lavs open onto the cross-aisle. tpg_70 / _71 hint that the left lav door faces the rows 5-6 aisle, but this is unconfirmed (question kept).

F/J bulkhead, J face (m07) and the J backs of the door monuments (m13, m14, m15) vs tpg_70 / _71. Cream laminate (#a5a096 rendered vs #a0948d) and grey wall boxes under the bins (#a4a7a4 vs #a9adb0) match. The J backs of the door-2 forward and door-3 monuments are now finished. Wrong: the curtain. In m07 it renders #2a2523, near-black, against #5e595a in tpg_71. It stands mid-aisle as a 0.12-0.2 m pole, tied at 1.1-1.2 m. In tpg_70 / _71 / _147 the curtain is pressed against the outboard panel edge, tied at the wall-box height (about 1.5 m), and fans out to about 0.3 m wide at the ceiling track. The model's wall boxes carry a blue top band; the photographed boxes are plain grey (the only blue is the small TV placard on the centre wall).

J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08, q13), checked against new in-service photos (The Alviator, ANA 777 PY HND-LHR, saved as ref/web/monuments/alv_IMG_7207-2 / 7209-2 / 7184). Four mismatches: (1) The bulkhead is not a solid wall. A see-through horizontal band about 0.18 m tall runs across both the centre and the outboard panels just above the monitors (7184, 7209); you look through it into THE Room. (2) The monitors are flat-mounted in thick charcoal frames: #343635 against a #e0e2e0 wall, 0.23 of the wall's luminance. They sit below that band at roughly seated eye height, not tucked under the bins at 1.78 m as in m08. The official py_37303 shows lighter grey frames (0.65 of wall), so the two sources conflict. (3) Each outboard panel has two charcoal-grey pockets side by side at floor level (7207: #5a5d5d, holding headsets and amenity kits), not a 5-high staggered column reaching 1.0 m. (4) The J/PY curtain is gathered and tied against the OUTBOARD panel (7209), not the centre wall as buildMonuments does. The monitor count of 2 + 4 and the dark kick strip are right.

Door-4 group (q13, m09, m10) vs py_37302, alv_IMG_7182 and the ANA map. The plain PY aft wall with two grey boxes, the wheelchair lav, the right galley and the row-30 monitors still agree. Regression: in r0 the PY curtain was a wide flat pleated panel against the centre wall edge, as in py_37302. In r2 (m09, m10) it is a navy 0.2 m tied tube standing in the middle of the aisle, 0.07-0.11 m clear of the wall. py_37302 shows untied full pleated panels about 0.35-0.4 m wide, hanging straight against the centre wall. The ANA map also shows an empty stowage box, about 0.4 m deep, between row 27 A/C and the wheelchair lav; the model has none.

Rear, door 5 (m11, m12, q19). The layout matches the map: fore-aft galleys, outboard lavs, centre closet plus baby lav, and the low stowage behind 41H/K. The rear curtain is a light-grey tied pole mid-aisle (m11); y_47300 shows wide, untied, full-height pleated panels. Colour conflict: the official y_47300 is light grey #9e9e9c, but the in-service alv_IMG_7255 shows the end-of-economy curtain dark charcoal-navy (#2b2624 in shade). The end wall of the galley work aisle (m12) is still a blank glowing white panel. The finishes of the new-config galley remain unverified.

Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12). The latches are now smaller and darker; aluminium carts, ovens and brewers are fine. The in-service economy galley (alv_IMG_7295 / 7297) confirms light-grey aluminium upper units and copper-red cylindrical turn latches on the carts. The upper stowage compartments are blank white slabs; the photo's are aluminium-grey with a dark handle recess and number plates. The door-1 centre/right galley step and the 2 cm slot (x 0.60 / 0.62, h 2.10 / 2.15) remain.

Curtains overall. All positions now exist: F front, door-2 fore and aft, F/J, J/PY, PY aft and rear. But the new _curtainGeo is one tied bundle, 0.12 m at the track, 0.09 m at the tie (1.1-1.2 m) and 0.2 m at the hem, placed 0.15-0.17 m from the panel edge. Every view (q01, m02, m04, m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m15) shows a free-standing pole in the middle of the walkway. The real curtains take two forms. J / F-J / J-PY curtains are pressed against the outboard panel, tied at about 1.5 m, and fan to about 0.3 m at the track (tpg_70/_71/_147, alv_7209). F front, PY aft and rear curtains are wide untied pleated panels (ffF, py_37302, y_47300). This is worse than r0 for PY and rear.

Jump seats. Now mid-grey on a grey pedestal (lalf_133 #595351), with one at the door-2 7A closet beside a narrowed closet door, as the photo shows. There are still 5 in total: door 1 ×2, door 2 ×1, door 5 ×2. There are none at doors 3 and 4 and none at R2. The ANA map draws three small boxes ahead of the door-5 galleys (2 left, 1 right); the model has 2.

issues.detail: Curtains are poles standing mid-aisle (regression for PY and rear)
issues.problem: addCurtain uses one tied curtainLoft for every curtain: 0.12 m wide at the track, 0.09 m at a tie at 1.1-1.2 m and 0.2 m at the hem. It is placed at xg 0.15-0.17 m from the panel edge, so it stands free in a 0.5 m aisle (q01, m02, m07, m08, m09, m10, m11, m15). The F/J curtain renders near-black in m07 (#2a2523 vs #5e595a in tpg_71).
issues.evidence: tpg_70/_71/_147 and alv_7209: J curtains pressed against the outboard panel, tied at wall-box height (~1.5 m), fanned to ~0.3 m at the track. ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle: F-front aisles each have two untied pleated panels, one at each edge. py_37302 and y_47300: PY-aft and rear curtains are untied flat pleated panels ~0.35-0.4 m wide against the centre wall. r0 m10 had this right.
issues.fix: src/10_mono.js: give addCurtain a style argument. (a) style 'tied' (tones F, C and J/PY): _curtainTied = curtainLoft([[0.02, 1.0], [0.8, 0.85], [1.45, 0.5], [1.55, 0.5], [1.8, 1.1], [CURTAIN_H - 0.01, 1.5]]) with the x radius 0.10 (0.30 m at the track) and the z radius 0.05; tie curtainLoft([[1.45, 0.55], [1.55, 0.55]]). Place it touching the outboard panel: xg = outboardEdge -/+ 0.075 (F-front L -1.545, R 1.545; door-2 fwd -1.545 / 1.545; door-2 aft -1.725 / 1.725). In buildMonuments, use the outboard rule for J/PY too: xg = right ? b.x0 - 0.075 : a.x1 + 0.075. (b) style 'hang' (PY aft 'Y', rear 'R'): an untied pleated panel curtainLoft([[0.02, 1.0], [CURTAIN_H - 0.01, 1.0]]) with the x radius 0.18 and the z radius 0.04, xg = centre-wall edge -/+ 0.19 (PY aft -1.24 / 1.26, rear -1.19 / 1.19). (c) F front: two 'hang' panels 0.18 m wide per aisle, at xa + 0.09 and xb - 0.09. Set MONMAT.curtainC / curtainF r 0.95 and lift their c to '#6a625c' so the shaded aisle reads about #5e595a.

issues.detail: J/PY bulkhead: solid wall, monitors high, wrong pockets
issues.problem: buildBulkhead makes the J/PY partition a solid wall. It puts light-grey tilted monitor housings at y 1.78 right under the bins and a 5-high staggered pocket column (0.16-1.00 m) on the outboard panels.
issues.evidence: alv_IMG_7184 and 7209 (in service): a see-through band ~0.18 m tall runs across the centre and outboard panels, with THE Room visible through it. The flat charcoal-framed monitors (#343635 on a #e0e2e0 wall) sit below the band, about 0.08 m under it. alv_IMG_7207: two charcoal pockets (#5a5d5d) side by side at floor level on the outboard panel.
issues.fix: In buildBulkhead, when m.monitor: build the wall as a lower part monoSection(x0, x1, 1.62) plus an upper part from 1.80 to H (gExtrude of monoSection(x0, x1, H) clipped with y >= 1.80, or a gBox for the centre panel), leaving a 0.18 m see-through slot. Add 0.03 m bulkCore mullions at each panel end and one at the centre. Move the tiltMonitor y from 1.78 to 1.42 and zero its tilt (flat mount). Change MONMAT.monHousing c to '#3c3e41' only if the user confirms (the official py_37303 shows light grey). Replace the PY outboard pocket column with two pockets: litPocket(B, X(cx + u, 0.22), {c:'#6b6e70', r:0.6, l:LAYER.fabric}, 0.24, 0.26) for u = ±0.28. Keep the bassinet mounts.

issues.detail: F ink-cloud walls read plain grey
issues.problem: inkWall fades the clouds with lowY = clamp(1.25 - y/H) and thresholds fbm at 0.46, so the wall above seat height is blank. m02 shows a 10-90 % luminance spread of 5 % (centre) and 20 % (lower left). The ground #dcddd8 renders cool neutral #cfd1d0.
issues.evidence: tpg_147 (ink147 crop): horizontal cloud bands over the whole wall up to the bins, stddev 13 on mean 166 (10-90 % spread ~18 %), warm grey-green ground #bab7a6, clouds #9c9988. The same is visible in ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle and tpa_IMG_0220.
issues.fix: inkWall: n = fbm(x / 0.9 + 40, y / 0.22 + 3, 256, 4, 23) (horizontal banding), t = clamp((n - 0.40) / 0.25, 0, 1) ** 1.2 * 0.9, and drop lowY (or use clamp(1.1 - 0.3 * y / H, 0.7, 1)). MONMAT.inkGround c '#d6d5cb', inkCloud '#8e9082'. Target a 10-90 % spread of about 15-20 % in m02.

issues.detail: Welcome galley aisle-end recess and under-monitor bays
issues.problem: The black upper unit fills the whole alcove to the aisle frame. The brewer stands proud on the counter; the two left units are ovens with beige windows.
issues.evidence: lalf_134: the glass-door cabinet ends about 0.35 m short of the aisle-end frame, leaving an empty recess with a light-grey back wall and the black counter running into it. Under the monitor are two framed open bays (brewer, cubby) behind a shelf lip. The left units are tall stainless chillers with round ring handles.
issues.fix: buildWelcomeGalley: gc = w/2 - 0.3 - 0.35. Add the recess back gBox(0.33, 0.98, 0.01) at V(w/2 - 0.2, 1.5, o) in {c:'#c9c9c7', r:0.5} and a light top gBox(0.33, 0.01, set) at y 1.99. Under the monitor, make two bays with black frames: gBox(0.02, 0.30, 0.2) side walls at mc - 0.42, mc, mc + 0.42, y 1.20, with back gBox(0.84, 0.30, 0.01) at o. Set the brewer box back to o + 0.1 inside the left bay (depth 0.18, not proud of the lip). Chillers: replace the card quads with a ring handle gTorus-like gCyl(0.03, 0.03, 0.01) in MONMAT.steel at y 1.30, and use MONMAT.steel for the body instead of alu.

issues.problem: MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.05 is unchanged. On the ANA map the door-3 lavs (with baby-change icons) are drawn clearly deeper than a THE Room row pitch, and the bar has angled walls behind it.
issues.evidence: ana_seatmap_73E rows 16-17: lav boxes ~95 px vs row pitch ~68 px; the bar block is followed by two angled lines converging toward 17E/F.
issues.fix: As in round 1: MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.45 for the lavs. Keep the bar at z0 + 0.9 and add two angled barAsh panels gBox(0.02, 2.0, 0.6) rotated ±0.5 rad from (±1.1, z0 + 0.9) toward (±0.6, z0 + 1.4). Check the row 17-27 legroom first (ask the user; see the questions).

issues.detail: Jump seats missing at doors 3, 4 and R2
issues.problem: L.jumps has 5 seats, with none at doors 3 and 4 and none at R2. Every Type A door on a 777 has an attendant station.
issues.evidence: lalf_133 shows the L2 seat on the aft monument beside the door; the map draws 3 boxes at door 5 (2 L, 1 R). There is still no photo for doors 3 and 4.
issues.fix: Add [2.46, dz[1][1], -1] on the 7K galley's outboard end, narrowing its outermost ash door (skip x > 2.25 in the ashDoors loop), and [-1.30, dz[4][1], -1] as a third seat at door 5. For doors 3 and 4, wait for the user's answer, or add stowable door-lining seats on the aft door frame (x ±2.25, z dz[k][1] + 0.05) as [A].

issues.problem: The bottleBlue emissive renders #1b3bbb, saturated solid blue; the blind renders #09090b.
issues.evidence: samchui_11: clear bottles with blue labels behind smoked glass, #454876 / #353855; blind #1d1c23.
issues.fix: In the fridge, use MONMAT.bottleClear for the bottle bodies and add a blue label band (bottle(..., lbl=true) with a label c '#3a55b0'). Set bottleBlue e 0.12 -> 0.02 and c '#3c4a8a'. MONMAT.blind c '#26252c', r 0.7.

issues.detail: Bar canopy reads as a floating plank
issues.problem: In q11 and m06 the canopy is a thin black slab with a white edge strip, projecting beyond the lav fronts, with a dark sign box above it.
issues.evidence: samchui_11: the black soffit is recessed flush between the flanking monument heads, with a lit white frame.
issues.fix: In buildBar, pull the canopy front back to the lav face plane (z offset 0) and close the gap to the ceiling with a black gBox(w, 0.12, 0.05) fascia above it. Keep the downlights.

issues.detail: PY-aft stowage box and door-5 end wall
issues.problem: The map shows an empty stowage box (~0.4 m) between row 27 A/C and the wheelchair lav; the model starts the lav at pz27 + 0.14. The door-5 galley work aisle ends in a blank glowing white wall (m12).
issues.fix: M('closet', -2.70, -1.62, pz27 + 0.14, pz27 + 0.52, {face: -1, h: 1.9, back: 'PY'}) and start the lav at pz27 + 0.54 (check the door-4 cross-aisle clearance). Give the aft work-aisle wall laminate with two stowage doors: gRBox(0.5, 0.9, 0.02) at y 1.5 with MONMAT.copper latches.

issues.detail: Door-2 R2 lining reads blue and lacks the placard
issues.problem: In m16 the Type A door face renders blue #5c68c4 (sky/sun term on the shell; lighting owner). The lining's OPEN placard is a 0.2 × 0.106 m quad.
issues.evidence: lalf_133 / lalf_134: cream door #a69888, a large red 'OPEN' arc arrow ~0.45 m wide at ~1.0 m, and a red arming-flag strap.
issues.fix: In the door-lining loop, enlarge the doorPlacard quad to gQuad(0.45, 0.30) at at(1.0, 0.006). Report the blue door tint to the lighting/shell owner.

questionsForUser: The J/PY bulkhead in the Alviator's 2026 photos (alv_IMG_7184 / 7209) has a see-through horizontal band above charcoal-framed monitors. ANA's official py_37303 shows light-grey frames. Should the model follow the in-service photo (charcoal frames, see-through band) or the official photo?
The end-of-economy curtain is light grey in the official y_47300 but looks dark charcoal in the Alviator's in-service alv_IMG_7255. Which colour should be used?
Where are the flight-attendant jump seats at doors 3 and 4, and at R2? No photo found shows them.
Do the door-2 forward lav doors face the rows 5-6 aisle, or the door-2 cross-aisle? (still open from round 1)
Should the door-3 lavs be made deeper to match the map (about 1.45 m), even though that moves rows 17-27 aft by about 0.4 m?
